explanation: Use an access-ordered LinkedHashMap to keep least-recent entries first. Lookup and reinsertion touch an existing entry; reinsertion preserves its old price. A new insertion beyond capacity removes the eldest entry. Capacity zero retains nothing. The operation adapter creates a fresh cache on every LruCache constructor command, allowing capacity changes, and validates every lookup and erase result.
timeComplexity: O(1) expected time per lookup, insert and erase.
spaceComplexity: O(c) retained entries for nonnegative capacity c.
